ratings_why.fun: Three ways to read one Debt pile give real turn-by-turn choices early, but once Debt stops costing anything the late game collapses into owing everything.
ratings_why.distinct: A shared, compounding debt that locks Tier up is unlike any of today's tribes, and Seven's exact-7 puzzle and the Fence's selling-as-payment feel new.

verdict_why: Debt's only cost is the Tier lock, which vanishes at Tier 6 or with Uncle Jack, so never paying becomes always right; that needs a real fix.

points.text: Debt's only penalty is the Tier lock, so at Tier 6 owing is free and you should never pay. Give Debt a cost that lasts, such as extra hero damage per 5 Debt when you lose, or interest paid in gold once you can't Tier up.
Uncle Jack Monedula plus Tick-Book Magpie is a free unit and a free Tier up every turn with no bill ever due. Let Jack lift the lock only for his own credit Tier up, or keep the lock above 10 Debt.
Sorrow and Joy is unclear: does 1 gold clear 2 real Debt, or does only the count for triggers and the Ledger double? Say which.
Rookery Don says "your Skim": it's unclear whether Orchard Heavy's and Gallows Lane Bagman's Skim also trigger it. The tier check assumes they do; write that in.
Memory gives Health only and only per 3 cleared, so the collection build grows tall but soft. +1/+1 per 3, or Attack too, would make the lump-payment turn feel like a payday.

standouts.why: Seven turns the whole recruit turn into landing on exactly 7 Debt, a puzzle no other tribe has.
Thorn Nest Fence makes selling a payment, and with Silas's stolen copies and Birds' Fly South it's a great cross-tribe hook.
Rookery Don rewards winning streaks with board-wide permanent stats, a clear capstone for the Skim build.

weakest.why: Gallows Lane Collector is a generic random +1/+1 buffer with a Debt trigger attached.
Oast Usurer is a plain loan: 3 gold now for 3 Debt, with nothing to remember it by.
Memory's Health-only payoff is the weakest reward for the build it anchors.

flags.note: With Tick-Book Magpie, a free unit and free Tier up every turn, and Debt never needs paying.
At Tier 6, or with Uncle Jack, every credit buy is free, so this is a free extra unit each turn.
Arne at 30 Debt gives about 120 stats a fight, and holding 30 Debt costs nothing late.
Belfry Jackdaw pays 2 gold a turn for owing just 1 Debt, which never has to be paid at Tier 6.
Whether a doubled clear removes 2 real Debt is not stated.
"Your Skim" may mean only the Don's Skim or every Skim you have.
The Ledger never goes down and Sorrow and Joy doubles it, so Grandmother Corbie's buff keeps climbing all game.
